desc:
A Wix App Market listing is the page site owners read before they install your app. Ecom Swift LLC writes the name options, tagline, description, benefits and image captions, following Wix listing guidelines, so the page is ready to enter in your Dev Center.

## What is a Wix App Market listing?

A Wix App Market listing is the public page for your app. It holds the app name, a short tagline, a longer description, a list of benefits, screenshots or images, pricing plan wording, support details and search terms. Site owners use it to decide whether the app fits their need, and Wix uses parts of it to show your app in search and category results.

## Why the listing deserves as much care as the code

Site owners scan the App Market quickly. They look at a name, a line of text and a few images, and decide in seconds whether to read further. If your tagline describes a technology instead of a result, or your images show empty settings screens, they move on to the next app.

A listing also sets expectations. When the text is honest and specific, the owners who install it are the right ones, and they are less likely to leave a complaint later. A vague or exaggerated listing brings installs from the wrong audience and early removals.

## How listing quality affects installs

A clear listing helps in three places. First, in search and category pages, where a precise name and relevant terms help the right owners find you. Second, on the page itself, where benefit-led text and captioned images show what the app does. Third, at the plan stage, where clear plan wording tells owners what each tier includes.

None of this can promise a rank in the App Market. Ranking depends on factors Wix controls, such as install activity and ratings. What a better listing can do is turn more of the visitors you already receive into installs.

## What a strong listing includes

- An app name that is short, easy to say and does not copy another app.
- A tagline that states the main result in one line.
- A description that opens with what the app does, then lists features.
- A benefit list written from the site owner's point of view.
- Search terms that match how owners describe their problem.
- Listing images with captions that explain each screen.
- Pricing plan wording that makes the differences easy to compare.
- Help and support text that tells owners where to go for answers.
- An app icon that stays readable at small sizes.
- A demo video script, where a video is wanted.

## How we write and prepare it

We start with your app, your target site owner and what makes the app different. We look at similar listings to understand the language owners already see. Then we write the name options, tagline, description and benefits, and check each against Wix's listing guidelines: no ranking promises, no incentivized reviews and no claims you cannot support.

The Basic package covers the core text and search terms. Standard adds up to five captioned images, plan wording, help text and benefit titles. Premium adds more images, an icon check, a demo video script, a review of similar listings and entry of the finished listing into your Dev Center.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Describe the result the owner gets, not the tools you used.
- Use screenshots from a real site with realistic sample data.
- Keep the same plan names on the listing and in the app.
- Update the listing when the app changes in a meaningful way.

**Avoid:**
- Promising a ranking or sales outcome.
- Asking owners for reviews in exchange for rewards or discounts.
- Copying text from competing listings.
- Filling the description with search terms and no real information.

## Who this is for

A developer with a good app and a plain-looking page. An agency launching its first public app. A team about to relaunch after a redesign who wants the listing to match.

## What we need from you

A short description of the app, screenshots or access to a test site, your plan structure and your target audience. Add us as a collaborator in your Dev Center if you want us to enter the text for you. We never need your password. We will send drafts for your comments before anything is entered.
